decisions.reason: The quoted sentence 'They share some similar clinical features and the accumulation of autofluorescent storage material' directly supports that neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (NCL) has the phenotype of autofluorescent storage material accumulation. The antecedent 'They' refers to 'The neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses (NCLs)' established in the first sentence. The statement is a direct declaration of a characteristic feature of the disease.

The quoted sentence states 'Since the discovery of the first causative genes, more than 530 mutations have been identified across 13 genes in cases diagnosed with NCL.' This explicitly identifies these genes as 'causative genes' for NCL. While the quote does not use the word 'causes' directly in the verb form, it unambiguously establishes these genes as the genetic basis causing the disease in diagnosed NCL cases. The relationship is clearly supported by the surrounding abstract which states these are 'causative genes.'
